evidence.quote: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AITM, purpose-built to accelerate breakthroughs by AI pioneers, from leading research labs to enterprises fueling business growth.
We primarily compete with hyperscalers who offer general purpose cloud computing as part of a broader product portfolio, several of which are also customers of, and partners to, CoreWeave.
Our network backbone supports the bandwidth and connectivity that our customers need to move large-scale distributed AI workloads.

It integrates state-of-the-art networking technology, including NVIDIA Quantum-X800(XDR) enabling 800Gbps of connectivity, NVIDIA Quantum-2 InfiniBand interconnect and NVIDIA Spectrum-X with RoCE or RDMA over Converged Ethernet for ultra-low-latency connectivity between racks of GPUs.

In October 2025, we also acquired Marimo, creator of the marimo notebook, an open-source, AI-native environment, to unify the generative AI development workflow and enable faster, smarter AI development.

We designed and built a carrier-grade network backbone engineered specifically for the ultra-low latency, high-throughput requirements of our customers' training, data replication, inference, and agentic AI initiatives.
As of December 31, 2025, we operated 43 data centers with over 850 MW of active power.
